description: This file contains tests for the 'codex-native-web-search' module, testing functions related to web search integration and configuration within the project.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Test suite initialization for individual features or functions.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion function for testing expected outcomes.

methods.name: buildCodexNativeWebSearchTool
methods.description: Builds the web search tool configuration for native Codex web search.

methods.name: describeCodexNativeWebSearch
methods.description: Provides a description or snapshot of the native web search state.

methods.name: patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload
methods.description: Injects or updates native web search payload within tool configurations.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeSearchActivation
methods.description: Determines if native Codex search is enabled based on configuration and model provider.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Normalizes and processes web search configuration settings.

methods.name: shouldSuppressManagedWebSearchTool
methods.description: Determines whether to suppress the default managed web search tool based on current setup.

methods.name: isCodexNativeWebSearchRelevant
methods.description: Checks if the current model configuration makes native web search relevant.

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "function", name: "read" }] };$/

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "web_search" }] };$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^    const result = patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload({ payload, config: baseConfig });$/
